title: Malformed WsFrame/StateChange degrades to Unknown, not error
description: ws/mod.rs parse_ws_frame: Degrading a malformed known-type frame to WsFrame::Unknown rather than Err is correct for long-lived event connections. Transport errors should terminate; single-frame parse failures should not. Unknown{type_name} carries enough info for logging. Terminating on schema mismatch would cause unnecessary reconnects. Defend this pattern.
